method: Four sequential direct executor invocations per backend/query mode, alternating order, after one warmup each. Driver timings include getMore; independent reference queries overlap. adira-expr-only strips generated ordinary helper matches from this risk workload while keeping exact expressions, raw business matches, and current stage placement. It is a query-shape A/B probe, not the historical compiler or a replacement for the HTTP benchmark.
